title: JLA foundation transfer items (authoring contract)
description: Educator-facing shape for a transfer item: the same reading skill, exercised on a source family the learner did not practice in. Recognition banks stay in data/foundation-authored-items.json (Claude). This schema does not invent pedagogy — examples in data/foundation-transfer-items.examples.json are labeled EXAMPLE and must not be counted as production coverage. See docs/foundation-transfer-items.md.

status.description: examples-only files never feed the learner loop. Production authoring uses a separate file with status draft|ready.

loadIntoAcademy.description: Must be false until academy is explicitly wired to load status=ready items. Examples stay false.

id.description: example-xfer-<skill>-<n> for illustrations; xfer-<skill>-<n> for real authored items.

label.description: Human-facing status. Example entries must include the word EXAMPLE.

skill.description: A real foundation-skill-graph id, preferably from the frozen starter set.

type.description: Always transfer. Recognition/practice items belong in foundation-authored-items.json.

sourceRef.description: Exact work, chapter, folio, or section — same convention as authored recognition items.

sefariaUrl.description: Primary-text link used to verify the citation before shipping.

practicedFamilies.description: Families this skill was practiced in (recognition bank / teaching contexts). sourceFamily must not appear here — that is what makes the item transfer.

whyTransfer.description: Educator note: which familiar families this is leaving, and why the new source still tests the same skill.

stem.description: Learner-facing prompt. Include a short on-page Hebrew excerpt plus translation. Do not use untaught jargon as the ask.

choices.description: Same shape as data/foundation-authored-items.json. Render shuffled; never ship a fixed visible correct index.

correct.description: Index into choices in this authoring file. Academy loading (later) should shuffle and may strip this key from the client payload.

feedback.description: Teaches after the answer. May name genre terms that the teach step already introduced.

misconceptions.description: Optional ids of named misconception models. Empty until the educator audit writes them.

difficulty.description: Null until calibrated from pilot data.

discrimination.description: Null until calibrated from pilot data.
